entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Oiva Emil Kalervo "Oippa" Tuominen was a Finnish fighter ace and a Mannerheim Cross knight of the second class. He flew over 400 missions and shot down 44 Soviet aircraft. He was the most successful Finnish biplane fighter ace, and also the most successful Finnish Fiat G.50 Freccia pilot.
